description: This Java class defines a custom exception `GroupMustBePendingToBeDeletedException` used within the Fineract project to indicate that a group cannot be deleted unless it is in the `Pending` state. It extends `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException` and provides a specific error message including the group ID.

classes.name: GroupMustBePendingToBeDeletedException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating a group cannot be deleted unless it is pending.

methods.name: GroupMustBePendingToBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific message containing the group ID.
